posts.title: How I publish to my site with Obsidian
posts.description: I built a CMS where I write in Obsidian, a plugin pings my Go API, markdown gets stored in Cloudflare D1, and the site updates immediately. It's absurdly overengineered and I love it.

posts.title: A definitive, entirely subjective guide to ricing Linux
posts.description: Ricing is the art of making your Linux desktop look unreasonably good for no practical benefit. I've been doing it for years, and I have opinions. Strong ones.
